decisions.statement: The store takes a path and a whole body rather than the keys a page has.
A key the body already has is restated in place.
A key the body has nowhere is added on the line before the closing.
A key told null is taken off the body.
Only a key indented by two spaces is matched.
A key that is no bare name refuses the call before any body is composed.
Every key is judged before the first one is written.
A body with no closing line is refused rather than guessed at.
A body nothing would move on counts as landed.
A body the store has nothing for is refused rather than made.
No task is ever taken away.
Each attempt reads the task afresh.
The caller states the commit message.
Nothing here decides the keys a completion changes on a task.

definition: a temper task's whole body written back with the keys a completion changes
